note: Schema A artifacts are from the reference implementation only. Other implementations need not produce byte-identical encode output; they MUST decode each artifact under its seed to the listed plaintext. Schema B error cases are verified deterministic at generation time.

schema_a.description: 64 KiB stress plaintext: byte i = i mod 251.
schema_a.name: stress_64k

schema_a.description: Plaintext embeds the 32-byte slug inline (must not be stripped/escaped).
schema_a.name: slug_inline

schema_a.description: Same plaintext+seed as `hello_world` but a distinct slug; artifact MUST differ.
schema_a.name: hello_world_slug2

schema_a.description: Same plaintext+slug as `hello_world` but a distinct seed; artifact MUST differ.
schema_a.name: hello_world_seed2

schema_b.description: 33-byte artifact with version byte 0x01 (the prior format version).
schema_b.name: bad_version_01

schema_b.description: Valid artifact decoded under an empty seed.
schema_b.name: empty_seed

schema_b.description: Valid artifact decoded under a deliberately mismatched seed.
schema_b.name: wrong_seed

schema_b.description: Valid artifact with the tail slug corrupted.
schema_b.name: corrupted_slug

schema_b.description: Valid artifact with a single payload bit flipped.
schema_b.name: bitflip_payload
